answer: Re-attestations are stored in fable and tide lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the signal graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1866 impostors cost 124 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
